Cedar was filed on time.

options.label: A
options.textMd: False, because Friday posting is prohibited.

options.label: B
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

options.label: C

explanationMd: Receipt at 14:00 is after the noon deadline; the earlier posting does not satisfy the receipt rule.
